name: L10 PanoLab three-producer pixel-unseen temporal appearance replay
question: Does the unchanged two-reference, reciprocal top-two-of-three appearance router transfer to three pixel-unseen targets spanning nlehuby, Nzau and Carto'Cité capture strata?

aggregation.references: Exactly two cross-collection strict entrance-ray windows per target.
aggregation.query_sequence: Exact reciprocal prev, anchor, next frames.
aggregation.per_frame: Unchanged strict entrance-ray crop and 0.35 CLIP + 0.25 DINOv2 + 0.40 mutual-patch-geometry score against the fixed two-reference bank.
aggregation.per_target_sequence_score: Arithmetic mean of the highest two of three per-frame target scores; deterministic ties by relation name.
aggregation.no_adaptation: No model, crop, reference count, frame count, feature weight, aggregation, threshold, target roster, target alias, producer stratum, or image may change after output.

accept_contract.source: Unchanged minima frozen from the original four consumed positives before every open-set and transfer panel.
accept_contract.rule: Emit SEARCH_PRIORITY_ONLY only when the sequence aggregate has unique top-1 and meets both score and margin thresholds; otherwise UNKNOWN_KEEP_SEARCHING.

required: three valid pixel-unseen human-truth rows spanning three capture producers
six cross-collection references and nine reciprocal query frames
zero target-way and item overlap with prior router cohorts
gate.failure_policy: Preserve the first result. Do not tune or resample this panel.

research_basis.title: Learning Sequential Descriptors for Sequence-Based Visual Place Recognition
research_basis.use: Motivates using temporal context to improve condition robustness. This replay is a deterministic reducer, not the paper's learned sequence descriptor.

research_basis.title: JIST: Joint Image and Sequence Training for Sequential Visual Place Recognition
research_basis.use: Motivates evaluating transfer across image and sequence regimes. This replay does not train or attribute performance to JIST.

claim_boundary.allowed: Pixel-unseen Development evidence for or against the unchanged temporal appearance router on exactly three target-way/item-disjoint Caen targets spanning three capture-producer strata in one same-provider eleven-target closed roster.
not_allowed: blind or independent adjudication, provider-disjoint, city-disjoint, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, or deployment confirmation
trained sequential-descriptor performance or attribution to the cited methods
exact physical identity authority, sign-to-building association, pixel portal grounding, entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, or safety
